suggestions.observation: Starts-to-permits ratio captures execution vs pipeline; a falling ratio (starts lagging permits) can flag construction softening before either level turns.
suggestions.rationale: Combines two housing leading indicators; the ratio may lead SPY more cleanly than either series alone by netting out common rate-driven trends.
suggestions.caveats: Both series SA; ratio is well-defined but permits/starts co-move strongly.

suggestions.observation: Housing Starts response to the cycle is rate-state dependent (2022-24 shock).
suggestions.rationale: Gating the starts signal by the mortgage-rate regime may sharpen it.
suggestions.caveats: Adds a second series; risk of overfitting the small OOS window.
